title: ASCEND Act
official_title: To require the Administrator of the National Aeronautics and Space Administration to establish a program to identify, evaluate, acquire, and disseminate commercial Earth remote sensing data and imagery in order to satisfy the scientific, operational, and educational requirements of the Administration, and for other purposes.
likelihoodReason: Introduced by Rep. Hurd (R-CO) with Rep. Bonamici (D-OR) and 6 cosponsors; passed the House and was placed on the Senate Legislative Calendar. Codifying a successful NASA data-acquisition pilot is bipartisan and low-cost, which favors Senate passage.
summary: Makes permanent a NASA program that buys commercial satellite imagery and Earth data for scientific research, building on a pilot the agency started in 2019.
brief: Establishes a permanent NASA program to acquire and share commercial Earth remote sensing data and imagery.

items.main: Names the Act the “Accessing Satellite Capabilities to Enable New Discoveries Act” (the “ASCEND Act”).
items.detail: Short-title section — citation name only; no substantive effect.

items.main: Directs NASA to establish a permanent program to acquire and share commercial Earth remote sensing data and imagery.
items.detail: Adds Section 60307 to title 51. The Administrator must establish, within the Earth Science Division, a program to acquire cost-effective commercial Earth remote sensing data and imagery for NASA's scientific, operational, and educational needs and, where appropriate, for other agencies and researchers. Acquisition terms may not prevent publication of the data for scientific purposes; the Administrator may set license terms for the widest possible use; and data is to be procured from U.S. vendors to the maximum extent practicable. An initial and then annual report to the Senate Commerce and House Science Committees must list agreements, vendors, license terms, and uses.

gaps: The bill establishes the program but does not authorize a specific funding level for data purchases.
It prioritizes U.S. vendors 'to the maximum extent practicable' but does not define when foreign data may be bought instead.

featured_quotes.name: Mr. Hurd
featured_quotes.text: This bill builds on a model that already works. In 2017, NASA launched the Commercial Small Satellite Data Acquisition Pilot Program to test whether commercially available Earth observation data could support NASA's scientific missions. The results were clear: Participating scientists found the data reliable, valuable, and highly effective across a broad range of research applications. The ASCEND Act takes that successful pilot and makes it permanent.

added: Permanent NASA Commercial Satellite Data Acquisition Program with annual reporting (new Section 60307 of title 51)
